activities.name: Private Tea Ceremony in a Yanaka Machiya
activities.description: A 90-minute private tea gathering in a century-old townhouse — one host, your party only, charcoal quietly ticking. Babies are welcome to doze on the tatami.
friction: narrow entrance — strollers parked at the door

activities.name: Wagashi Making Workshop
activities.description: Shape three seasonal nerikiri sweets at a lively shared table, then eat them with matcha. Great with kids; the room runs cheerful and loud.

activities.name: Kintsugi Repair Atelier
activities.description: Repair a broken vessel with lacquer and gold in a silent six-seat studio. Precision work — and the quietest room in this catalogue.

activities.name: Sumida Riverside Cycling Tour
activities.description: Fifteen easy kilometres along the river with a guide, ending at a standing coffee counter. Cancelled outright in rain.

activities.name: Kiyosumi Garden Stroll & Sketching
activities.description: A guided slow loop of a stone-and-water stroll garden with paper and pencils provided. Lovely — and mostly shelterless.

activities.name: Taiko Drumming Family Session
activities.description: An hour of full-body drumming that children adore. Ear protection provided; it is still gloriously, unavoidably loud.
friction: VERY loud — even with ear protection

activities.name: Sake Brewery Tasting Flight
activities.description: Six small pours from family breweries with the stories behind each label. Strictly adults.
friction: strictly 20+ — no infants or children admitted

activities.name: Ukiyo-e Woodblock Printing Studio
activities.description: Print your own copy of a wave from hand-carved blocks, layer by layer, in a calm four-table studio a lane off the tourist route.

activities.name: Depachika Food Hall Safari
activities.description: Ninety minutes underground in the best food halls on earth — tastings included, elbows required.
friction: dense crowds — babies in carriers, not strollers

activities.name: Immersive Digital Art Galleries
activities.description: Rooms of moving light that swallow you whole. Unforgettable, mobbed, and loud — the whole internet is in the queue with you.
friction: timed entry sells out a day ahead

activities.name: Evening Lantern Alley Walk
activities.description: Cobbled lanes, paper lanterns, and quiet stories after dark. Starts at 19:30 — after most dinners begin.
friction: evening only — conflicts with most dinner plans

activities.name: Ozu Washi Paper-Making Workshop
activities.description: Pull your own sheets of washi at a 350-year-old paper house, then emboss and dry them to take home the same day. Calm, bright workroom.
